# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

sqlpipe v2.0 is now available. This release contains one breaking change, one new flag, and one performance update.

## Breaking Change

The `/v2/users` endpoint no longer contains the `name` field. The API now splits the `name` field into `first_name` and `last_name`. If you use the `/v2/users` endpoint, you must update your client code to read `first_name` and `last_name`.

## New Flag

sqlpipe v2.0 adds the `--incremental` flag. You can use the `--incremental` flag to process only new records or modified records.

## Performance Update

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in sqlpipe v1.0. The file writer writes Parquet data faster because it uses a new memory layout.
